# coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-core-ref-delivery-timing

<!-- Generated by tools/export_results.py. Edit only the Experiment and Observations sections. -->

## Experiment

`coop --git` (two agents with messaging and a shared git remote) with the frozen reference settings (`gemini-3.8-flash` on Vertex AI, `medium` thinking, 500 steps, compaction at 128K tokens, step counter, `$40` per-agent cost cap, `-c 4` concurrency) on the 10-pair `core` subset (spanning Python, Go, Rust, and TypeScript), adding `delivery_timing: true` (`configs/variants/delivery_timing_medium.yaml`). Compares directly against the [`coop --git` `core` reference baseline](../coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-core-ref/summary.md) (5/10) and the [`solo` `core` reference baseline](../solo-msa_v2-gemini-3-8-flash-core-ref/summary.md) (6/10).

## Observations

- **6/10 (60%) passed (6/10 clean-merge passes, 0 merge conflicts, 0 step-limit cutoffs, 0 agent errors)** at `$21.68` (`79` min, `15` retries), improving over the [`coop --git` `core` reference baseline](../coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-core-ref/summary.md) (`5/10 = 50%`) by **+1 pair (+10.0pp)** and matching the [`solo` `core` reference baseline](../solo-msa_v2-gemini-3-8-flash-core-ref/summary.md) (`6/10 = 60%`).
- **+1 win and 0 losses vs. `core-ref` (`9/10` identical outcomes)**: `llama_index_task/17244` (5,6) passed here and failed in `core-ref`, while all 5 pairs that passed in `core-ref` also passed here.
- **All 10 pairs merged cleanly (7 clean, 3 identical branches)** with `291` total messages sent (median `26`/pair, down from `307` and median `32`/pair in `core-ref`), `1,623` total steps (median `81`/agent), `27` compactions (vs. `28` in `core-ref`), and **28.2% faster wall time** (`79` min vs. `110` min in `core-ref`).
